# Clay (pinned)

Nic Barker's Clay, a single-header C layout library, compiled into the Clay library (`src/clay.c` defines
`CLAY_IMPLEMENTATION`).

- Upstream: https://github.com/nicbarker/clay, release `v0.14`.
- Archive: `https://github.com/nicbarker/clay/archive/refs/tags/v0.14.tar.gz`,
  SHA-256 `ee8f6477020dd72afe8cf6f8d3ab6855980028289a2b677a1423d17aab983585`.
- License: zlib (`LICENSE.md`).
- No local changes; only `clay.h` and `LICENSE.md` are kept.
